αἴδετο: αἰδέομαι — feel shame, be shy of; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾐδεῖτο), + inf.: ’was ashamed to’ · also + acc., ’stood in awe of, respected’ (αἴδετο … πατροκασίγνητον)
βιήσατο: βιάζομαι — overpower, force, press hard; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐβιάσατο), unaugmented; with κε ’would have overpowered’
δειλῶν: δειλός — wretched, miserable, worthless; masc. gen. pl.: ’(for) the worthless’
διάκτορος: διάκτορος — the guide; standing epithet of Hermes, masc. nom. sg.; sense not actually known (’the guide’ is a conventional gloss)
θῆρας: θήρ — wild beast; masc. acc. pl.
κεκοτηότι: κοτέω — bear a grudge, be angry; perf. part. act. masc. dat. sg. (epic -ηότ-, = κεκοτηκότι): ’angered’
κρατερῆφι: κρατερός — strong, mighty; fem. dat. sg. with epic -φι (= Attic κρατερᾷ), instrumental, with βίηφι
λητὼ: Λητώ — Leto, mother of Apollo and Artemis; fem. acc. sg. (Λητώ)
νικῆσαι: νικάω — conquer, prevail; aor. inf.: ’to win, to conquer’
πάθομεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπάθομεν): ’we suffered’
πέλεθρα: πλέθρον (epic πέλεθρον) — plethron, a land measure of about a hundred feet; neut. acc. pl.
τελέθουσιν: τελέθω — be, prove to be (poetic, = εἰμί in force); pres. 3 pl.: ’are’
φέρεις: φέρω — carry, bring; pres. 2 sg.: ’you carry’
φθινύθουσιν: φθινύθω — waste, consume, cause to waste away (epic lengthened form of φθίνω); pres. 3 pl. transitive: ’waste, consume’
ἀγροτέρας: ἀγρότερος — of the wild, wild; fem. acc. pl.
ἀντιόωσα: ἀντιάω — come to meet, partake of; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic diectasis (= Attic ἀντιῶσα), + gen.
ἀπέπεμπε: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; impf. 3 sg.
ἄμμες: ἐγώ — I; nom. pl., epic/Aeolic ἄμμες (= Attic ἡμεῖς): ’we’
ἐνιαυτὸν: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a year’
ἔκπαγλος: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, dreadful, astounding; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἔχες: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 2 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχες): ’you had’
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a bowstring (ἡ δ’ ὑπὸ καλὸν ἄεισε ’and it sang beautifully’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a helmet (ἡ δ’ οὐκ ἔγχος ἔρυτο ’and it did not keep out the spear’)
ὑπερφιάλοισιν: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὑποστὰς: ὑφίστημι — place under; intr. (aor. 2 act. and mid.) undertake, promise; aor. 2 part. act. masc. nom. sg., intr.: ’having promised’
